title: 剑刃重击
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：左、右、下、右。用短剑压迫敌人的武器，然后强行切割脖子
second_page: 剑刃重击会消耗大量体力，但是他带来了对敌方弱点的致命打击和控制能力

en_us.title: Strong Edge
en_us.first_page: Input: Left, Right, Down, Right. Press the enemy's weapon aside with the short sword, then force a cut into the neck.
en_us.second_page: Strong Edge costs a lot of stamina, but it lands a lethal blow on a weak point and keeps the enemy under control.
